main_text.p: strum, Job 6.27: item ex usu Chaldæo Cogi-tatio, Voluntas: plur. רְעִים Amici: Cogita-tiones. Fem. רעות Amica.
רעה m. Amicus רעיה f. Amica.
רעות f. Amica, Proxima: Chald. Voluntas, Esra 5.17. item Contritio, quod est ex רעע.
רעיונים m. p. Chald. Cogitationes: רעיונך Cogitationes tuæ, Dan.2 20: רעיוני Cogitationes meæ, Dan.7.28: רעיונהי Cogitationes ejus, Dan.4.16.
מרע m. Amicus, Sodalis: plural. מרעים. At מרעים est Maligni, a רוע.
רעל Horrere, Tremere. Hophal הרעל Tremere factus est.
רעל m. Horror, Tremor: Stupor, Sopor.
רעם Tonare: Perstrepere, Personare, Commoveri, Percelli. Hiphil הרעים Intonare: Commovere.

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek words are copied as far as legible; the vocalisation marks on the Hebrew are uncertain in places, and the Hebrew entry forms in lines 2 and 8-9 may carry small errors. Entry boundaries are inferred from the hanging layout.
